Sources. Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Country-Year Core v12. Correlates of War Project, National Material Capabilities v5.0 and Inter-State War Data v4.0 (Sarkees and Wayman). Where the Correlates of War files record −9 for a missing value it is treated here as missing.

Simulated panels use a seeded generator, so a given set of controls always produces the same figure. Every panel has a table view with a CSV download. Runs entirely in your browser — no server, nothing sent anywhere.
